title: KitchenAid KQ913 Digital Waterproof (IPx7) Kitchen and Food Scale, LED readout, 11 Pound Max Capacity, White
description:
About this item
UNIQUE FEATURE: IPX7 Waterproof rating for easy clean up. Scale's digital components are water tight and can be rinsed under water. See instruction manual for additional cleaning information.
MAX CAPACITY: Dry ingredients: 11 LB X 0.1 Oz and 5000 grams x 1 gram Liquid ingredients: 5000 millilitre x 1 millilitre and 176 FL Oz x 0.1 FL Oz
BUTTONS: Touch capacitive buttons will not collect kitchen dust or food particles and easily wipe clean.
HOLD: Press the HOLD button to lock in the last recorded weight into the LED display. Weight remains visible even when the bowl or container is removed.
TARE: Weigh all ingredients into one container by using the Tare feature to zero out weights in-between additions. Also works to zero the Weight of any container before adding food

reviews_5s: This scale is bigger than the cheap one I bought a few years ago. I liked my old one because it was my first but this scale beats the old one. It’s simple to use, clean and it’s a gorgeous colour, I got the aqua one. Easy to read and it powers off when not in use in case you forget to do it yourself.Does its job well and is cute and sleek. There are different types of measurements on this scale. I use it for espresso and bagging breastmilk. Light weight and I store it on its side out of the way.I’m pleased with this scale. I have purchased several food scales before and this just feels different and sturdy.I love this scale. It is clean, nice and super easy to navigate. I bought one for myself and one for someone’s wedding gift. Chic and perfect. I would buy again.For the price, a gem of a scale...it will drift if the batteries are flaking, but otherwise seems rock steady. I use mine EVERY day...all sorts of uses as it is very portable.Weight …. For itWorks really wellLove the sleek look and was very easy to figure out.Works great. High quality. Easy to clean. Highly recommendSimple and straightforward, love that I can just rinse it off to clean

Completely useless if you need to weigh small amounts like adding salt or yeast to a bread recipe. First unit always started up at -3 to -4 grams, requiringa. re-tare just to zero. I ordered a replacement which zeroed out correctly but I had a much more serious issue with both scales I tried. I was able to slowly add 28g without the scale reading any changes, no other scale I've used behaved this way.it’s super sensitive turns on by itself. only used it for 1 month and it’s low battery :(It stopped working within 3 weeksI use this for meal preparation. Seemed fine at first but then I started to notice amounts seemed like more than would be 50g etc. Using two other scales it was weighing ~20% light. So I have been eating more carbs than I thought for months. Also the tare and units button are too close so anytime I reset the weight I hit the units and it's in oz instead of grams. Looks nice but not great for daily use as meal prep scale.It appeared a little strange when I opened the box that the Kitchen Aid logo was faded,, but thought it was jut me, so I set the scale up and put a jar on it and from the beginning it would not Tare, it would not weigh and when it did weight it jsut did it when it wanted. I even slowed down thinking it was me trying to rush. tjhis is not the kind of product I expect from Kitchen Aid.It's constantly turning on, batteries ran low in a week or less. Its accuracy isn't the best either, takes awhile to settle.I loved this scale for the 2.5 months it worked. I’ve already had to change its batteries a couple of weeks ago. Stopped working this week.
